translation.name: Yuusa chichame yaunchukia tura yamaram chichamjai aarmau

content: Jesús yama nagkamchaku shuarti takamainchaun iwainakmau

Tresa imajnia tsawan tsawaarmatai Galilea nugkanam yaakat Caná tutainam nuwa nuatmau atin asamtai, Jesúsan ipainak nina unuinatairi ainancha ipaawaruiti. Turamu asar Jesús weakai nitasha wearuiti. Nina nukurisha nu jiistammaunam pujau.
Nuwa nuatmau nagkamnamtai utsaanawar umuinamunam umutai vino tutai amukau. Tumamtai nina nukuri Jesúsan chicharuk: Vinonka amukarai, tusa tinaiti.
Tusa tama Jesús ayak: “Amesha, ¿urukamtai winasha nusha turutme? Wii takamaintruka eke tsawanka jeatsui”.
Takaisha María nui shuar ajamau irunun chicharuk: “Atumka ni waritrutmatig nuka imatiksarmek umirkatarma”, tusa tinaiti.
Timatai seis muits kaya uun najankamunam, judío aina pegker jasmi tusar entsan aimak nijaama jaku aina nu matsatu. Nu muits ainanmagka “cincuenta, setenta litros” tumain entsan aima jakaruiti.
Jesús inatai ainan chicharuk: “Nu muits aina nui entsa shikikrum aimratarma, tusa takai aimraruiti”.
Turawarmatai nitan chicharuk: Yama nagkamchakrumka nuwenmaun chichamra nu shikikrum susatarma tusa takai, nuna susaruiti.

Turam nuwenmaun chichamrauka entsan vino amajsamunka nekatsuk umar, pegker nekaprauwaiti. Inatai entsan shikikar aimraru ainaka, entsanapi aitkawa tusar shir nekaina. Tumainaig nu nuwenmaun chichamrau shuar nuwan nuatun untsuk

chicharuk: “Chikich aina nuwan nuatainakka yama nagkamchak pegkeran ajamasar shuar nukap umararmatai, umutain pegkerchaun ajamau armayi. Turasha ameka nuka turutsuk yama nagkamchakum pegker ajamasmesha, aruma nuisha imanuk ajamame”, tusa tinaiti.
Galileanam yaakat Caná tutai a nui, Jesús yama nagkamchak nina senchirin iwainaktasa, entsan vino amajsauwaiti. Nuna turamtai, nina unuinatairi aina juka Yuusa uchirimpapita tusar shir nekaawaruiti.
Nuna tura Jesús nukurin, yachi ainan juki ashi nina unuinatairi ainajaimak yaruak, nijai iruuntsar yaakat Capernaúmnum jeawaruiti. Tuma ishichik tsawan nu yaaktanam pujusaruiti.
Yuus ememattasa iruuntai jeanam shuar matsatun Jesús jiira ishiakmau
Judío ainan jiistari Pascua tutai jeastatuk jasmatai, Jesúsjai Jerusalénnum jeawaruiti.
Tuma Yuus ememattasa iruuntai jeanam Jesús wayajkama, shuar vacan, oveja ainan, paum ainajaimak utsaawar suruinak, tura kuitan yapajinak matsatun wainkauwaiti.
Tura wainak nuap chapikmarmau atatmaun juki, shuar suruinak nui utsaana matsatunka, nita tagkuri ainajai iwijar aa ishimuk, kuitan yapajinancha nagkimruk nugka akaketak, mesarincha nagkimrukuiti.
Tura pauma surin ainan chicharuk: “Ju aina juka ashi aa jiirtaarma. Wina Aparu jea juka yutai surutaigka amajsairpa”, tusa tinaiti.
Nuna takai nina unuinatairi ainasha Yuusa chichame aarmaunam chichaak: “Amina jeemin akasmatakun senchi waitajai”, tu aarmauwa nuna aneararuiti.
Judío apuri aina chichainak: “¿Urukamtai, shuar chichame anturtai uruka imanikmesha shuarsha aitka jiirmesha ishimme?” tusa tiaruiti.
Tuinakai Jesús nitan ayak: “Jea puja ju yumpuarakrumnasha, tres tsawantaik ataksha wii jeamkattajai”, tusa tinaiti.
Nuna takai judío apuri chichainak: “Cuarenta y seis uwítin jeamkamua nuka ¿tres tsawantaik jeamkattam?” tusa tuina.
Jesúska nunaka jean taku tichauwaiti, antsu nina iyashin pachis taku tinaiti.
Jesús nuna tina nunaka, ni mantamna nantakmatai, nigkiapi pachimas tinaita tusar nekaawaru ainawai. Tumainak Yuusa chichamen aarmauwa nuna, tura Jesús timauncha nekaspapita tiaru ainawai.
Yama nagkamchak shuar aina Jesúsan nekaspapita timau
Jesús jiisat Pascua tutain inagkastasa Jerusalénnum jeaa pujus, shuar turumainchaun iwainak takakai, nukap shuar aina nekaspapi Yuusa uchiriyaita tusar tiaruiti.
Tumainakaisha Jesúska nita enentaimmaurinka shir nekau asa, nekaspapi enentaimturainawa tusagka tichauwaiti.
Nigka shuaran enentaimmaurinka shir nekau asa, chikich shuar aina, ju shuarka tu enentaimainawai tusar ujatkarti tusagka tichauwaiti.
